caption: Live match data → explainable match intelligence
voice: Live match data tells you what happened. Inside the Game tells you why it matters, for every fan, as it happens.

caption: The raw feed, live: 22 players + ball at 10 Hz, down to each player's feet
voice: Here is the raw feed, live. Twenty two players and the ball, ten times a second, down to each player's feet. Every second it becomes deeper data: the expected goals race, possession, momentum and ball speed.

caption: 3D ball-flight forecast: calls the shot on target before it arrives
voice: Our physics model forecasts the ball's flight. Watch the shot. It calls it on target before the ball arrives, accurate to about fifteen centimetres.

caption: Multi-agent commentary on Microsoft Agent Framework + Azure OpenAI, fully traced
voice: A team of A I agents on Microsoft Agent Framework explains every moment. The stats agent grounds the facts, the tactics agent explains why it matters, and the narrator writes the line. Every step is traced.

caption: Ask the AI: an agent with function calling over the live match data
voice: And you can just ask. The agent calls live match data tools, and answers only from what they return. You can see exactly which tools it used.

caption: Personalised: casual or analyst, favourite player, any language
voice: The persona agent tailors it to you. Casual or analyst, your club, your player, in your language. Here, live Turkish commentary while the camera follows one striker.

caption: Automated match recap
voice: At full time, the recap agent writes the match report automatically.
Inside the Game. Built with Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure OpenAI and Azure Container Apps. Explainable match intelligence for every fan.
